evidence: Two flat solid-colour panels split the 9:16 frame vertically; no texture, grain or lighting falloff on the backgrounds. The ingredient pile and the pouch are clean cut-out photos/renders with hard alpha edges, moving rigidly (slide, tilt, scale) with no deformation, no texture boiling and no physics. The pouch is masked by the panel seam, so it slides out from 'behind' the left panel: a layer mask, typical of an After Effects / template composite. Fixed layout repeats in every flavour shot: 'Just the Fun Part' logo top-right, 'Real Belgian Chocolate' badge bottom-right, 'Filled with ...' caption bottom-left.

Element motion is perfectly linear/eased keyframe motion (pouch rotates about a fixed pivot and slides out then back), the hallmark of keyframed 2D animation rather than a camera or a generative model.

story.summary: A 28-second looping product-range ad for 'Just the Fun Part' chocolate-filled mini waffle cones: four flavour cards built on one template, ending with the slogan 'Only The Best Part Of The Sundae Cone!'.
story.hook: 0-1 s: no intro; the first frame is already a full product card (hazelnut pile + pouch on brown/green) with 'Filled with Hazelnut cream & Milk chocolate' readable at once.
highlights: One template, four colourways (0-20.8 s): only the colours, ingredient pile and pouch change, so viewers compare flavours at a glance and the production cost is minimal.

Ingredient-first composition in every card: the raw ingredients (hazelnuts, pumpkin and cinnamon, marshmallows, mint and dark chocolate) sit next to the pack and sell the taste before the packaging does.
Pouch slides out from behind the colour seam (e.g. 1.4-3.7 s): a simple mask trick that gives depth and motion without any 3D.
Seamless loop (27.7-27.88 s): the end card wipes straight back into the first frame, so on autoplay feeds the ad replays without a visible restart.
